whatIs.heading: What is Screen Recording?
whatIs.body: Screen recording captures everything displayed on your screen — your desktop, a specific window, or a browser tab — as a video file.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.body: This tool uses the browser's built-in Screen Capture API. No software to install, no data sent to a server.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.body: The recording is processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. The video file stays on your device.

howItWorks.step1: Click Start Recording and pick the screen, window, or tab to share.
howItWorks.step2: Your browser will prompt you to select what to capture. Choose and confirm.
howItWorks.step3: Click Stop Recording when you are done.
howItWorks.step4: A preview will appear below. Use the Download button to save your recording.

alerts.browserUnsupported: Your browser does not support screen capture. Try Chrome, Edge, or Firefox on desktop.
alerts.tip: In the sharing dialog, choose Window or Tab instead of Entire Screen to avoid capturing the browser's recording notification bar.

note: The recording is kept temporarily in your browser. Refreshing or closing the page will erase it. Download before navigating away.

guide.mainTitle: Free Online Screen Recorder – Record Your Screen Instantly Without Downloads
guide.intro1: 🎥 Need to record your screen for tutorials, bug reports, presentations, or gameplay?
guide.intro2: A browser-based screen recorder lets you capture your screen instantly without installing heavy software. Your screen recording runs directly inside the browser, making it fast, private, and easy to use.
guide.intro3: Whether you're a developer, teacher, content creator, or remote worker, an online screen recorder is one of the fastest productivity tools available.

whyUse.heading: Why Use an Online Screen Recorder?
whyUse.body: Traditional desktop recorders often require installation, setup, permissions, and large downloads. Modern browser-based screen recorders simplify everything.

keyBenefits.heading: Key Benefits
keyBenefits.item3: ✅ Record full screen, tab, or app window
keyBenefits.note: Many modern screen recorders now work directly in-browser using Screen Capture APIs and MediaRecorder technology.

howTo.heading: 🛠 How to Record Your Screen Online

growing.heading: 🔥 Why Browser-Based Screen Recording Is Growing
growing.body: Online screen recording tools have become popular because users want faster workflow, better privacy, no software clutter, cross-platform support, and a simple UX. Modern web APIs now allow secure screen recording directly inside browsers.

faq.heading: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes. Many modern tools record locally in your browser without uploading files.
faq.q2: Does screen recording work on mobile?
faq.a2: Desktop browsers generally provide better support. Mobile browsers may have limitations depending on OS and browser.
faq.q3: Can I record audio with screen recording?
faq.a3: Yes. Most screen recorders support microphone audio, browser tab audio, and system sound.
faq.q4: What format is the video saved as?
faq.a4: Common formats include WebM and MP4.

final.heading: Final Thoughts
final.body1: A browser-based screen recorder gives users the fastest way to capture and share content without complicated setup. Whether you're teaching, debugging, presenting, or creating videos, online screen recording makes the workflow simple and efficient.
